title: Architecture Documentation

architectureSurfaces.responsibility: Roadmap, session continuity, standards and execution evidence
Foundation validation, security, observability, runtime references and roles
Knowledge governance, prompt registry, agent registry, evaluation assets and quality gates
Reusable templates, scaffolds, generators, manifests and testing governance contracts

architectureMap.relationship: Roadmap tasks are closed through current and archived execution evidence.
Governance records foundation task closure; product evidence remains in the independent product repo.
Governance records knowledge task closure; product evidence remains in the independent product repo.
Governance records template task closure; product evidence remains in the independent product repo.

consistencyRules: Architecture documentation preserves independent Git boundaries between root governance and product repositories.
Governance roadmap and execution evidence are the closure source for roadmap tasks.
Product repositories remain the source for product artifacts, validators and contracts.
Documentation-only tasks do not claim runtime architecture changes without product diffs.
Documentation-only tasks do not modify VERSION files.
Future roadmap tasks remain unopened until explicitly selected.
Architecture gaps are recorded without closing setup, onboarding, runbook or final audit tasks.
